reviews.comment: Great dude, taught the material super well considering its his first time teaching. Never tested material outside of teaching range. Curved the class to an 84 for an A too. Did review sessions before every test and taught everything. Super caring guy and an accessible professor. Made physics much more approachable. Definitely take him!

Potential to be a really great professor; however his inexperience in teaching was noticeable. He was not able to teach us concepts and applications as well as some more experienced professors. However, for his first year teaching, I can tell he is a really smart guy who has the tools to become a great lecturer. Very accessible outside of class.

For his first year teaching Don't Panic, I think he did great and he definitely cares about his students. However, I hated this class (not his fault). The tests make up 93% of your grade and there is no homework, so it's up to you to learn pretty much everything on your own. This works fine for some students, but I struggled a lot.

Wonderful instructor! He knew how to make the course easy to understand, and was super willing to help outside of class during office hours and in his own time. If I had to recommend anyone for 206 it would be him!
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class
